about_p1: Dental Clinic is a modern dental clinic providing comprehensive top-quality services in Volgograd.
about_p2: Our mission is to restore the health and beauty of every patient's smile. We specialize in minimally invasive treatment methods, using modern equipment and proven protocols. Our team of experienced specialists ensures a comfortable and painless visit, regardless of the complexity of the clinical case.
about_p3: We believe that quality dental care should be accessible to everyone. Our doctors constantly improve their skills and keep up with the latest advances in dentistry. From preventive check-ups and hygiene to complex surgical procedures and implants — we are ready to handle any task.
about_adv_1: Experienced team of dentists and hygienists
about_adv_3: Specialization in cosmetic dentistry and smile design
about_adv_4: Sedation for patients with dental phobia
about_adv_8: Warranty on all types of work
cert_2_title: Course in Implantology and Bone Grafting
cert_3_title: Course in Cosmetic Dentistry and Smile Design
about_phil_p1: We view every patient as an individual with unique needs and goals. Oral health is the foundation of overall body health.
about_phil_p2: Our approach is based on prevention, education, and personal attention. We don't just treat teeth — we teach patients to care for their smile for life.
about_phil_li_4: Continuous professional development of the team
about_phil_p3: We use innovative technologies and proven methods to deliver results that exceed expectations. Your smile is our responsibility.
doc1_desc: A qualified dentist and founder of Dental Clinic. A versatile specialist with 2+ years of experience, helping patients achieve a healthy and beautiful smile.
doc1_approach_text: no pain, no unnecessary procedures, focus on a natural smile and a clear treatment plan.

doc2_desc: Implant surgeon and aesthetician with 5+ years of experience. Specializes in implantation and aesthetic smile reconstruction. Creates natural results using modern materials and technologies.
doc2_philosophy_text: implantation as an art — restoring smiles and confidence for years to come.

tech_section_title: We Use the Latest Technologies at Our Clinic
tech_section_subtitle: Depending on the type of treatment, our team may use one or more of the following technologies during your visit.
tech_ai_desc: Our advanced artificial intelligence technologies help accurately diagnose problems, ensuring the most effective treatment plan.
tech_xray_desc: Our digital X-rays create detailed images of teeth and jaw with minimal radiation, improving safety and diagnostic accuracy.
tech_laser_desc: Using laser technology, we perform precise and gentle procedures that speed up healing and reduce discomfort.
tech_3d_desc: 3D scanners allow us to accurately assess the condition of teeth, plan treatment, and create custom restorations with high precision.
hero_subtitle: Innovative technology, experienced doctors, and care for every patient
reviews_cta_text: Already visited us? Share your experience!
br_hero_subtitle: Reliable restoration of a row of teeth using modern prosthetic structures
br_intro_text: A dental bridge is a fixed prosthesis used to replace one or more missing teeth. It rests on adjacent abutment teeth, restoring function and aesthetics.
br_type1_desc: A classic bridge supported by two abutment teeth. Reliable and widely used.
br_type2_desc: Supported by a single tooth at the edge of the row. Used when an adjacent tooth is missing.
br_type3_desc: Bonded with adhesive, no grinding required. Minimal preparation of adjacent teeth.
br_type4_desc: Supported by implants. Does not require grinding healthy teeth.
br_pricing_note: The exact price depends on the material, number of units, and condition of the abutment teeth.
br_faq1_a: When 1–3 teeth in a row are missing and adjacent teeth are healthy. This is a fast solution taking 2–3 weeks.
br_faq2_a: No, it's done under anesthesia. You may feel pressure but no pain. Afterward there may be mild sensitivity for 1–2 days.
br_faq3_q: How long does a bridge last?
br_faq3_a: On average 10–20 years depending on material and care.
br_faq4_q: What should I do if my bridge breaks?
br_faq4_a: See your dentist immediately. Small chips can be repaired; serious damage will require remaking (1–2 weeks).
ext_hero_subtitle: Gentle and safe tooth extractions for adults and children, including complex surgical cases
ext_intro_text: A tooth extraction is a safe surgical procedure performed under reliable anesthesia by an experienced dental surgeon. We create comfortable conditions and follow modern safety standards.
ext_kids_title: Children's Tooth Extraction — A Gift From the Tooth Fairy! 🧚‍♀️
ext_kids_intro: Removing a baby tooth at our clinic isn't just safe — it's magical! The child receives their extracted tooth in a beautiful gift box with a special "Letter from the Tooth Fairy" design.
ext_gift1_text: Featuring tooth fairy artwork — the child can place the tooth under their pillow for the tooth fairy or keep it as a memento
ext_gift2_text: With the message "You're a hero today! The Tooth Fairy is proud of you!" and a space for parents' signature
ext_gift3_text: Stickers, coloring pages, or a small gift as a token of appreciation for their bravery
ext_gift4_text: "I had my baby tooth removed! I'm a true hero!" (can be hung on the wall in a child's room)
ext_kidsinfo1_text: We explain everything in a playful way. The tooth isn't a "loss" — it's "making room for a new, strong tooth" and "a gift for the tooth fairy"!
ext_kidsinfo2_text: The child leaves the clinic smiling and tear-free — with a unique memory of how brave they were!
ext_ind1_text: The tooth is destroyed and cannot be restored
ext_ind3_text: Impacted or in an incorrect position
ext_gal4_meta: With a gift from the fairy
ext_pricing_note: Prices include anesthesia. The exact cost is determined after examination.
ext_faq1_q: Is it painful to have a tooth pulled?
ext_faq1_a: No. With the anesthesia injection, you won't feel pain, only pressure. There may be discomfort for 1–3 days afterward.
ext_faq2_q: How long does it take to heal and when can I work?
ext_faq2_a: Extraction takes 5–20 min. Healing takes 1–2 weeks. You can return to work the next day.
ext_faq3_q: What shouldn't I do after an extraction?
ext_faq3_a: For the first 24 hours: don't smoke, don't drink alcohol, don't rinse vigorously, avoid hot food, and don't drink through a straw.
ext_faq4_q: How is a tooth extracted in children?
ext_faq4_a: A playful approach with gentle anesthesia. We give a gift from the tooth fairy.
fil_hero_subtitle: Restore your smile with strong, aesthetic fillings at our clinic
fil_intro_text: To restore teeth affected by decay, we use modern tooth-colored filling materials that preserve the health and natural look of your smile.
fil_intro_highlight: Durability, aesthetics, and gentle care for tooth tissue
fil_benefit_2: Precise color matching to natural teeth
fil_benefit_4: Comfortable, gentle anesthesia and careful placement
fil_type1_desc: A modern material matched to tooth color. Strong and aesthetic, with a natural appearance.
fil_type2_desc: A classic material with decades of proven use. Very strong, suitable for back teeth.
fil_type3_desc: A material that releases fluoride to protect the tooth. Ideal for front teeth in children and adults.
fil_pricing_note: The cost depends on the situation and is determined after examination.
fil_faq1_a: We use modern tooth-colored composite fillings. They're strong, aesthetic, and not noticeable.
fil_faq2_q: How long does it take to place a filling?
fil_faq2_a: Usually 30–60 minutes per tooth, depending on the extent of decay, but we work quickly and comfortably.
fil_faq3_q: How do I care for a filling?
fil_faq3_a: Brush twice a day, use floss, and avoid hard foods. Regular checkups extend the filling's lifespan.
fil_faq4_q: Can a filling fall out or break?
fil_faq4_a: Over time, any filling wears down. If it cracks or chips, it's best to come in for a checkup right away — it's easier and cheaper to fix early.
fil_faq5_a: No, the procedure is done under local anesthesia. You may feel pressure and sound, but no pain.
imp_hero_subtitle: Reliable, long-lasting tooth restoration with modern implants
imp_intro_text: Implantation is the surgical placement of a titanium implant into the jawbone, which serves as an artificial root for a future crown. It fully restores chewing function and aesthetics without affecting adjacent teeth.
imp_benefit_3: No need to grind healthy teeth
imp_type1_desc: Standard titanium implants. Suitable for most cases. Durable and reliable.
imp_type2_desc: Advanced systems with improved coating. Integrate faster and distribute load better.
imp_type3_desc: Compact implants for complex cases or patients with thin bone. Less surgical trauma.
imp_p1_desc: A classic solution for one tooth
imp_pricing_note: The exact cost is determined after a CBCT scan and consultation. Payment in installments is available.
imp_faq1_a: Yes, the procedure is performed under local anesthesia and is safe. Implants are made of biocompatible titanium that is not rejected by the body.
imp_faq2_q: How long does it take to heal?
imp_faq2_a: Typically 3–6 months, during which time the implant fuses with the bone (osseointegration). Premium systems integrate faster — 2–4 months.
imp_faq3_q: Can I get implants if I have diabetes?
imp_faq3_a: Implantation is possible with controlled diabetes. Blood sugar control and careful aftercare are important. A doctor's consultation is mandatory.
imp_faq4_q: What if I don't have enough bone?
imp_faq4_a: If bone volume is insufficient, bone grafting, sinus lifts, or short/narrow implants can be used. There's a solution for any case.
imp_faq5_a: It depends on the implant quality, the patient, and aftercare. With good hygiene and regular checkups, implants last 20–30 years or more.
pro_hero_subtitle: Restoring your smile and chewing function in cases of complete or partial tooth loss
pro_intro_text: A removable denture is an appliance with artificial teeth that fits over the gums and can easily be taken out. Suitable when several or all teeth are missing, it restores chewing, speech, and aesthetics.
pro_type1_desc: Classic acrylic dentures. Suitable for full or partial restoration. Affordable cost.
pro_type2_desc: Flexible nylon-based dentures. More comfortable and soft, suitable for sensitive gums.
pro_type3_desc: Dentures with a metal framework. Stronger, preserve remaining teeth, more durable than acrylic.
pro_p1_li2: Color matching for teeth and gums
pro_pricing_note: The exact cost depends on the number of teeth to be replaced, the material, and the need for additional procedures (extractions, treatment).
pro_faq1_q: How quickly can I get used to a removable denture?
pro_faq1_a: The first days may be uncomfortable. Adaptation usually takes 1–3 weeks. It's important to wear the denture consistently in the early days and return for adjustments if needed.
pro_faq2_q: Can I eat anything with a removable denture?
pro_faq2_a: Once you've adapted, you can eat most foods. Avoid very hard, sticky, or chewy foods (nuts, taffy). Start with soft food.
pro_faq3_q: How do I care for my denture?
pro_faq3_a: Remove the denture daily, clean it with a special brush, and floss between any remaining teeth. Store it in water or a special solution when not wearing it. Clean your gums with a soft brush.
pro_faq4_q: Can I sleep with my denture in?
pro_faq4_a: It's not recommended. Gums need to rest. Remove the denture at night, store it in water, then rinse and put it back in the morning. This extends its lifespan and keeps your gums healthy.
pro_faq5_q: How long do removable dentures last?
pro_faq5_a: On average, 5–10 years. Over time, gum shape changes and the denture may become less comfortable. Replacement is recommended every 5–7 years or when fit changes.
rc_hero_subtitle: Gentle tooth preservation under the microscope
rc_intro_text: When the tooth's nerve becomes inflamed, endodontic treatment can save the tooth and avoid extraction. Treatment under a microscope ensures precision.
rc_type1_desc: Mechanical and medicated canal treatment. Suitable for simple cases without complications.
rc_type2_desc: Treatment under a surgical microscope. Precise treatment of complex canals.
rc_type3_desc: Repeat treatment of previously poorly filled canals or roots in case of recurring inflammation.
rc_type4_desc: When saving the tooth isn't possible, we perform a gentle extraction followed by implantation.
rc_p3_desc: Removal of old filling material and reprocessing
rc_pricing_note: Price is per canal. The final cost is determined after X-ray diagnostics. Complex cases (2–3 canals, retreatment) may cost more.
rc_faq1_a: No, the treatment is done under local anesthesia and is completely painless. You may feel only mild pressure.
rc_faq2_q: How long does the treatment take?
rc_faq2_a: Usually 1–2 visits of 1–1.5 hours each. Complex cases may require 3–4 visits.
rc_faq3_q: How long does a treated tooth last?
rc_faq3_a: With quality treatment and regular checkups, a tooth can last 10–20 years or even a lifetime.
rc_faq4_a: If the inflammatory process has affected the tooth pulp, the only alternative is extraction. The best prevention is timely treatment of cavities.
rc_faq5_q: What should I do if pain occurs after treatment?
rc_faq5_a: Mild sensitivity for 2–3 days is normal. If the pain is severe or lasts more than a week, see your doctor for a checkup.
cos_hero_subtitle: Teeth whitening, veneers, and restorations — everything for a dazzling smile
cos_intro_text: Modern aesthetic dentistry works wonders: a snow-white smile, flawless tooth shape, and natural beauty are no longer a dream but a reality. Our specialists use advanced technology to create the smile of your dreams.
cos_type1_desc: Professional whitening with ZOOM 4 and Opalescence systems. Up to 12 shades lighter in a single procedure with safe effects on enamel.
cos_type2_desc: Thin E-max ceramic shells that transform your smile by masking imperfections. Ideal aesthetics and durability.
cos_type3_desc: Restoring the shape and color of teeth using premium-grade composite materials. Removes chips and corrects shape in a single visit.
cos_faq1_q: Is teeth whitening safe for enamel?
cos_faq1_a: Yes, when done by a dentist. We use certified systems and adjust the strength of the formula to your teeth, then protect the enamel with special products afterward.
cos_faq2_q: How long does the whitening effect last?
cos_faq2_a: On average, the effect lasts 1 to 3 years, depending on habits (coffee, tea, smoking) and oral hygiene. We provide simple recommendations to make the whiteness last as long as possible.
cos_faq3_q: Do teeth need to be filed down for veneers?
cos_faq3_a: Generally, yes — just a little. A thin layer of enamel is removed so the veneers sit flat and look natural. Modern veneers are very thin, so the intervention is minimal.
cos_faq4_a: No, we don't allow pain. We use local anesthesia when needed, and whitening may cause only mild temporary sensitivity. We discuss in advance how to make the visit comfortable.
cos_faq5_q: Can I whiten my teeth if I have fillings?
cos_faq5_a: Only your natural enamel whitens — fillings and crowns don't change color. So after whitening, fillings in the smile zone sometimes need to be replaced to match the new tooth shade.
smile_meter_subtitle: Move the sliders and see how close your smile is to a Hollywood smile
smile_rec_white_text: Your smile could use more whiteness. Professional whitening will help you achieve a radiant result.
smile_rec_align_text: Teeth alignment has the biggest impact on how a smile looks. Veneers and crowns can visually straighten your teeth.
smile_rec_shape_text: The right aesthetic restoration can make your smile shape even more expressive.
smile_rec_great_text: Excellent result — almost a Hollywood smile! All that's left is to make it last with our specialists.
crn_hero_subtitle: Aesthetic, reliable crowns restore your tooth's natural look and durability
crn_intro_text: Crowns restore severely damaged teeth while preserving their function and appearance. This is a micro-prosthesis that fully covers the tooth and protects it from further damage.
crn_type1_desc: A metal base with a ceramic coating. A good combination of strength and aesthetics.
crn_type2_desc: Fully ceramic crowns made of zirconium dioxide. Maximum aesthetics without metal.
crn_type3_desc: Plastic crowns worn while the permanent one is being made. Protect the tooth from damage.
crn_type4_desc: A precious metal. Ideal biocompatibility, suitable for those with allergies.
crn_pricing_note: The final cost is determined after a doctor's examination.
crn_faq1_q: How long does it take to place a crown?
crn_faq1_a: Usually 2 visits over 1–2 weeks. At the first visit, the tooth is prepared and a temporary crown is placed; at the second, the permanent crown is fitted.
crn_faq2_q: Does the tooth need to be filed down?
crn_faq2_a: Yes, the tooth is slightly filed down so the crown fits securely and looks natural. Everything is done under anesthesia, so it's painless.
crn_faq3_q: How long does a crown last?
crn_faq3_a: On average, 10 years or more. The lifespan depends on the material and care.
crn_faq4_q: How do I care for a crown?
crn_faq4_a: Brush your teeth twice a day, use floss, and avoid biting hard food. Visit for a checkup every 6 months.
crn_faq5_a: We check the tooth and gum before placement. If there's inflammation or decay, we treat it first.
